analyticalDashboards.description: Dashboard for monitoring overall inventory health by combining key trends in units on hand and inventory value with purchasing, receiving, transfers, stock movements, and write-offs over time. It helps teams spot changes in stock levels and the operational drivers behind them (e.g., PO volume/amount, receipt and variance quantities, transfer volumes, and write-off costs). By default, it is scoped to the last 12 months, with additional product-related filters applied.
analyticalDashboards.title: Inventory Health & Stock Levels

widget.title: Inventory Value — In-Store Channel by Year

analyticalDashboards.description: Dashboard that monitors supply chain performance and purchase order activity, combining supplier scorecard KPIs (quality, delivery, cost) with inventory health and stock/value trends over time. It highlights purchasing quantities by channel (in-store, online, and North region) and inventory units/value on hand by month, quarter, and year. By default it focuses on the last 12 months, with additional predefined attribute filters applied.
analyticalDashboards.title: Supply Chain & Purchase Orders

filterContexts.description: Default filters: last 12 months + store region + channel
filterContexts.title: Filters — Inventory Health & Stock Levels

filterContexts.description: Default filters: last 12 months + store region + channel
filterContexts.title: Filters — Supply Chain & Purchase Orders

metrics.description: Shows the total quantity received by summing Receipt Quantity from the Goods Receipt data within the selected scope (e.g., time period, supplier, or product). Use it to track inbound receipt volumes and compare received quantities across segments.
metrics.title: Total Receipt Quantity (Goods Receipt)

metrics.description: Shows the total quantity variance recorded at goods receipt by summing the Variance Quantity across goods receipt transactions. Use it to track and analyze discrepancies between expected and received quantities.
metrics.title: Total Variance Quantity (Goods Receipt)

metrics.description: Shows the total inventory units available on a given day by summing the Units on Hand from the Daily Inventory Snapshot dataset across all included items and locations.
metrics.title: Total Units on Hand (Daily Inventory Snapshot)

metrics.description: Sums the PO Amount to show the total value of purchase orders. Use it to track and compare overall purchasing spend across time, suppliers, or other reporting dimensions.
metrics.title: Total PO Amount (Purchase Order)

metrics.description: Tracks the total number of purchase orders by summing the PO Count from the Purchase Order dataset. Use it to monitor overall PO volume and compare it across time periods or other business dimensions.
metrics.title: Total PO Count (Purchase Order)

metrics.description: Sums the line amounts across purchase order line items to show total purchase spend. Use it to track overall spend and compare totals across time, suppliers, products, or other dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Line Amount (Purchase Order Line Items)

metrics.description: Shows the total number of units ordered by summing Quantity across all purchase order line items. Use it to track overall purchasing volume and compare ordered quantities across dimensions such as supplier, product, or time.
metrics.title: Total Quantity (Purchase Order Line Items)

metrics.description: Shows the total quantity of stock moved by summing Movement Quantity across Stock Movement records, reflecting how many units were transferred in or out. Use it to track overall movement volume for the selected filters and time period.
metrics.title: Total Movement Quantity (Stock Movement)

metrics.description: Total Cost Score (Supplier Scorecard) sums Cost Score values to show overall cost performance across the currently selected supplier scorecard records. Use it to compare total cost scoring by supplier, time period, or other scorecard dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Cost Score (Supplier Scorecard)

metrics.description: Totals the Delivery Score from the Supplier Scorecard data to show overall supplier delivery performance for the currently selected records. Use it to track and compare delivery performance totals by supplier, time period, or other relevant dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Delivery Score (Supplier Scorecard)

metrics.description: Shows the total Quality Score by summing Quality Score values from the Supplier Scorecard data. Use it to track and compare overall supplier quality performance within the current report scope (such as selected suppliers, time periods, or other breakdowns).
metrics.title: Total Quality Score (Supplier Scorecard)

metrics.description: Shows the total number of units transferred by summing Transfer Quantity from Transfer Orders, within the current reporting scope (such as selected time period, location, or other filters).
metrics.title: Total Transfer Quantity (Transfer Order)

metrics.description: Shows the total cost amount written off by summing Write-Off Cost from the Write Off data. Use it to track overall write-off costs across the currently selected filters and time period.
metrics.title: Total Write-Off Cost (Write Off)

metrics.description: Total quantity of items written off, calculated by summing the Write-Off Quantity in the Write Off dataset. Use this metric to monitor overall write-off volume and compare it across slices such as time, location, or product when filtered.
metrics.title: Total Write-Off Quantity (Write Off)

metrics.description: Shows the total on-hand inventory by summing the Current Stock values from the Inventory Health dataset, respecting any selected filters and reporting context.
metrics.title: Total Current Stock (Inventory Health)

metrics.description: Shows the total inventory coverage in days by summing Days of Cover across the selected scope. Use it to monitor overall inventory health and understand how many days current stock is expected to last.
metrics.title: Total Days of Cover (Inventory Health)

metrics.description: Shows the total monetary value of inventory on hand by summing Inventory Value from the Daily Inventory Snapshot. Use it to track and compare inventory value across the selected scope, such as by date, location, or other report filters.
metrics.title: Total Inventory Value

metrics.description: Calculates the difference between Total Units on Hand (from the daily inventory snapshot) and Total Inventory Value within the same reporting scope. Use it to compare changes in unit counts versus value movement under the selected date, location, or other filters.
metrics.title: Units on Hand (Daily Inventory Snapshot) vs Inventory Value Change

metrics.description: Calculates the difference between Total Inventory Value on hand and Total Movement Quantity to highlight where changes in inventory value are not aligned with the volume of stock being moved for the selected filters and scope. Use it to spot periods or locations with unusual gaps between value held and units transferred.
metrics.title: Inventory Value vs Movement Quantity (Stock Movement) Change

metrics.description: Shows the net change between total stock movement quantity and total purchase order count for the selected filters and time period. Use it to compare how physical inventory movement is shifting relative to purchasing activity over time or across business dimensions.
metrics.title: Movement Quantity (Stock Movement) vs PO Count (Purchase Order) Change

metrics.description: Shows the difference between the total number of purchase orders and the total purchase order amount, helping you compare changes in purchasing volume versus spend. Use it to spot time periods or segments where PO counts and PO value move in different directions.
metrics.title: PO Count (Purchase Order) vs PO Amount (Purchase Order) Change

metrics.description: Shows the difference between the total Purchase Order header amount and the summed line-item amounts for the same purchase orders. Use it to spot and quantify discrepancies between header-level PO values and underlying line items when analyzing purchasing spend across dimensions like time or supplier.
metrics.title: PO Amount (Purchase Order) vs Line Amount (Purchase Order Line Items) Change

metrics.description: Shows the net difference between total purchase order line amount and total goods receipt quantity for the selected scope. Use it to highlight potential changes or discrepancies between ordered value and received volume when comparing suppliers, products, or time periods.
metrics.title: Line Amount (Purchase Order Line Items) vs Receipt Quantity (Goods Receipt) Change

metrics.description: Shows the net received quantity at goods receipt after subtracting recorded receipt variances (Receipt Quantity minus Variance Quantity) for the selected scope. Use it to see how much received volume remains after discrepancies and to compare this adjusted receipt quantity across time periods, suppliers, or products.
metrics.title: Receipt Quantity (Goods Receipt) vs Variance Quantity (Goods Receipt) Change

metrics.description: Shows the net difference between total variance quantity recorded at goods receipt and the total transfer quantity on transfer orders within the selected reporting scope. Use it to understand whether receipt variances are being offset by transfers, or whether variances exceed the volume being moved.
metrics.title: Variance Quantity (Goods Receipt) vs Transfer Quantity (Transfer Order) Change

metrics.description: Shows the net change in units by subtracting written-off quantity from transferred quantity within the current reporting scope (e.g., selected time period, location, and product). Use it to compare inventory moved via transfer orders against inventory lost through write-offs for the same filters.
metrics.title: Transfer Quantity (Transfer Order) vs Write-Off Quantity (Write Off) Change

metrics.description: Compares changes in write-off volume versus write-off cost by calculating the net difference between Total Write-Off Quantity and Total Write-Off Cost for the current filters and time period. Use it to see whether write-off quantity is increasing faster or slower than write-off cost.
metrics.title: Write-Off Quantity (Write Off) vs Write-Off Cost (Write Off) Change

metrics.description: Compares write-off costs to supplier quality performance by showing the difference between Total Write-Off Cost and Total Quality Score for the current selection. Use it to see whether write-off costs are trending higher or lower relative to supplier quality within the same reporting scope.
metrics.title: Write-Off Cost (Write Off) vs Quality Score (Supplier Scorecard) Change

metrics.description: Shows the difference between a supplier’s total Quality Score and total Delivery Score (Quality minus Delivery) within the current filters or breakdowns. Use it to quickly see whether quality performance is ahead of delivery (positive) or delivery is ahead of quality (negative) for the selected scope.
metrics.title: Quality Score (Supplier Scorecard) vs Delivery Score (Supplier Scorecard) Change

metrics.description: Shows the difference between total Delivery Score and total Cost Score in the Supplier Scorecard for the selected data, indicating whether delivery performance is scoring higher or lower than cost performance. Use it to compare the balance between delivery and cost outcomes by supplier, time period, or other scorecard dimensions.
metrics.title: Delivery Score (Supplier Scorecard) vs Cost Score (Supplier Scorecard) Change

metrics.description: Compares Supplier Scorecard cost performance to Inventory Health on-hand inventory by calculating the difference between total Cost Score and total Current Stock within the same filters and reporting context. Use it to see whether cost scoring is increasing or decreasing relative to available inventory.
metrics.title: Cost Score (Supplier Scorecard) vs Current Stock (Inventory Health) Change

metrics.description: Compares on-hand inventory to inventory coverage by calculating the net difference between Total Current Stock and Total Days of Cover within the same Inventory Health filtering context. Use it to identify situations where stock levels are running ahead of, or behind, the expected days of coverage in the selected scope.
metrics.title: Current Stock (Inventory Health) vs Days of Cover (Inventory Health) Change

metrics.description: Shows the total Supplier Scorecard Cost Score for the Online sales channel only. Use it to compare overall cost performance for online activity by supplier, time period, or other scorecard dimensions.

metrics.title: Current Stock (Inventory Health) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the total on-hand inventory (current stock) restricted to the Online sales channel. Use this metric to monitor inventory availability for online sales, while still respecting any other filters applied in the report.
metrics.title: Current Stock (Inventory Health) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the total on-hand inventory (current stock) for the North region using Inventory Health data. Use it to monitor inventory availability in North-focused reports and dashboards within the current reporting filters and context.

metrics.description: Shows total inventory Days of Cover for the In‑Store sales channel, indicating how many days current in‑store stock is expected to last within the selected scope. Use it to monitor inventory health specifically for in‑store operations.
metrics.title: Days of Cover (Inventory Health) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in units ordered on purchase order line items for the In-Store sales channel by comparing the current month’s quantity to the previous month. Use it to monitor whether in-store purchasing volume is increasing or decreasing over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Quantity (Purchase Order Line Items) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in the total quantity of purchase order line items for the Online sales channel. Use it to understand how this month’s online purchasing volume differs from the previous month when trending over time or breaking down by dimensions such as product or supplier.
metrics.title: MoM: Quantity (Purchase Order Line Items) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in total purchase order line item quantity for the North region by comparing the current month’s ordered units to the prior month. Use it to monitor whether purchasing volume in the North is rising or falling over time and to analyze the trend by dimensions such as supplier or product.
metrics.title: MoM: Quantity (Purchase Order Line Items) — North Region

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in in-store Units on Hand based on the Daily Inventory Snapshot, calculated as the current month’s units on hand minus the prior month’s value. Use it to monitor whether in-store inventory levels are rising or falling over time at a monthly cadence.
metrics.title: MoM: Units on Hand (Daily Inventory Snapshot) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in inventory units on hand for the Online Channel, based on the Daily Inventory Snapshot. Use it to track how online-available inventory has increased or decreased compared with the prior month.
metrics.title: MoM: Units on Hand (Daily Inventory Snapshot) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in North-region inventory units on hand by comparing the current month’s daily inventory snapshot total to the prior month. Use it to track whether North-region stock levels are rising or falling over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Units on Hand (Daily Inventory Snapshot) — North Region

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in Inventory Value for the In-Store channel by comparing the current month’s inventory value to the previous month. Use it to monitor in-store inventory value trends over time and quickly spot increases or decreases month to month.
metrics.title: MoM: Inventory Value — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in inventory value for the Online sales channel by comparing the current month’s Online Inventory Value to the prior month. Use it to monitor whether online inventory levels are increasing or decreasing over time when reporting by Month/Year.
metrics.title: MoM: Inventory Value — Online Channel

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in Inventory Value for the North region by comparing the current month’s inventory value to the prior month. Use it to see whether North’s inventory value is rising or falling over time when you analyze results by Month/Year.
metrics.title: MoM: Inventory Value — North Region

metrics.description: Measures the month-over-month change in in-store stock movement quantity by comparing the current month to the prior month. Use it to track whether inventory movement through the In-Store channel is increasing or decreasing over time within the applied report filters.
metrics.title: MoM: Movement Quantity (Stock Movement) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Measures the month-over-month change in online stock movement quantity by comparing the current month’s moved units to the previous month. Use it to see whether online stock movement volume is trending up or down over time, typically when analyzed by Month/Year.
metrics.title: MoM: Movement Quantity (Stock Movement) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in stock movement quantity for the North region by subtracting the previous month’s movement quantity from the current month. Use it to monitor whether inventory movement volume in North is trending up or down over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Movement Quantity (Stock Movement) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in the number of In-Store purchase orders by subtracting the prior month’s in-store PO count from the current month. Use it to monitor whether in-store purchase order volume is increasing or decreasing from one month to the next.
metrics.title: MoM: PO Count (Purchase Order) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Measures the month-over-month change in Online-channel purchase order volume by subtracting last month’s Online PO count from the current month’s count. Use it to monitor whether Online purchasing activity is increasing or declining over time.
metrics.title: MoM: PO Count (Purchase Order) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in the number of purchase orders in the North region, comparing the current month’s PO count to the previous month. Use it to track whether PO volume in North is increasing or decreasing over time.
metrics.title: MoM: PO Count (Purchase Order) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in Purchase Order Amount for the In-Store sales channel, comparing the current month’s in-store PO spend to the prior month. Use it to track how in-store purchasing is trending over time and quickly spot increases or declines versus last month.
metrics.title: MoM: PO Amount (Purchase Order) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in Purchase Order Amount for the Online sales channel by comparing the current month’s total to the prior month. Use it to track whether online PO spend is increasing or decreasing over time at a monthly level.
metrics.title: MoM: PO Amount (Purchase Order) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in total Purchase Order Amount for the North region by subtracting the prior month’s PO spend from the current month. Use it to monitor how North purchasing is trending over time and quickly spot increases or decreases from one month to the next.
metrics.title: MoM: PO Amount (Purchase Order) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in total purchase order line item spend for the In-Store sales channel, calculated as the current month’s line amount minus the prior month. metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in total purchase order line amount for items tied to the Online sales channel, comparing the current month to the previous month. Use it to see whether online-related purchasing spend is increasing or decreasing over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Line Amount (Purchase Order Line Items) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in total purchase order line amount for the North region by comparing the current month’s spend to the prior month. Use it to track whether North-region purchase order spending is rising or falling over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Line Amount (Purchase Order Line Items) — North Region

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in total Goods Receipt quantity for the In-Store channel by comparing the current month’s received quantity to the previous month. Use it to monitor whether inbound receipt volumes for in-store operations are increasing or decreasing over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Receipt Quantity (Goods Receipt) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in goods receipt quantity for the Online sales channel by comparing the current month’s receipts to the prior month. Use it to monitor whether inbound receipt volumes for online operations are increasing or decreasing over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Receipt Quantity (Goods Receipt) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in goods receipt quantity for the North region by comparing the current month’s received quantity to the previous month. Use it to track whether inbound receipt volume in the North is increasing or declining over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Receipt Quantity (Goods Receipt) — North Region

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in goods receipt quantity variance for the In-Store channel by comparing the current month to the prior month. Use it to see whether receiving discrepancies in in-store operations are increasing or decreasing over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Variance Quantity (Goods Receipt) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in goods-receipt quantity variance for the Online sales channel, comparing the current month’s variance to the previous month. Use it to see whether receiving quantity discrepancies for Online orders are improving or worsening over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Variance Quantity (Goods Receipt) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in Goods Receipt variance quantity for the North region by comparing the current month’s variance against the prior month. Use it to monitor whether receipt quantity discrepancies in North are improving or worsening over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Variance Quantity (Goods Receipt) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in the number of units transferred on Transfer Orders for the In-Store sales channel, comparing the current month’s transfer quantity to the previous month. Use it to track how in-store transfer volume is trending over time.

facts.description: Number of days the current inventory is expected to cover demand, used to monitor stock sufficiency in the Inventory Health dataset.
facts.title: Days of Cover

sql.statement:
SELECT
    inv.product_id,
    inv.warehouse_id,
    SUM(inv.on_hand_units) AS current_stock,
    SUM(COALESCE(sales.daily_sales, 0)) * 30 AS units_30_day,
    SUM(inv.on_hand_units) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(sales.daily_sales, 0)), 0) AS days_of_cover
FROM {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_inventory_snapshot_daily inv
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ol.product_id, oh.order_date, SUM(ol.quantity) AS daily_sales
    FROM {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_order_line ol
    JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_order_header oh ON ol.order_id = oh.order_id
    GROUP BY 1, 2
) sales ON inv.product_id = sales.product_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
